semantics.clock: All sequential logic on positive clk edge, as stated in original final sentence.
semantics.reset: Original areset requirement: asynchronous positive edge assertion resets q to zero; while asserted reset dominates clock operations.
semantics.priority: Original (4): load has higher priority than ena; reset dominates both.
semantics.load: Original (2): on positive clk edge load data[3:0].
semantics.shift: Original (3): on positive clk edge with ena and no load, shift right with zero entering q[3].
semantics.hold: With no reset, load, or ena, preserve register contents.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; no initialization is added. Verification establishes state by reset before functional checks.

numeric.shift: Logical right shift one bit, q[0] discarded, q[3] zero

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral state model grounded in original requirements; shift calculated by unsigned integer division by two.
verification.sampling: Drive controls at falling edge; compare after rising-edge nonblocking assignments settle. Check asynchronous assertion away from clock edges and no changes from controls alone.
cases: Reset off-edge and with conflicting controls
All 16 loads with ena both low and high
All 16 loaded states shifted to zero
Reset held across edges and deassertion without state change
verification.failure: $fatal mismatches and bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Power-up register state is unspecified; tests do not require a particular value before reset.
